correctness.rationale: From exact monomial moment m_n, substitute v=n(1-u); uniform comparison with Gamma-Laplace profile A(log n) has O(n^-1) absolute error, and A bounded away from zero. Reciprocal moments produce a phase-uniform Riemann sum for H_theta(zeta) on compact Re zeta>0 with controlled t=0 and infinity tails. Fourier multiplier Gamma(alpha+1-ik omega) has no zero, so A and h share minimal period; same holds for Q=1/A. Laplace uniqueness, period-average normalization and compactness prove no two distinct projective phases coincide. Integer floor(exp(theta+jT)) realizes every phase; constant h reproduces the standard power kernel. Independent quadrature for alpha=.25, eps=.4, omega=1.25 yields H_0(1.5)/H_0(1)=.389235400725 and opposite-phase ratio .415057878462. Finite quadrature checks one profile only; the analytic arguments prove all continuous positive periodic h.
